drawing_order.note: Pack signs of object-minus-viewer position in model coordinates: negative X/Y/Z contribute bits 4/2/1. Execute that octant list in stored order, preserving repeated and omitted commands.

runtime_variants.name: Experimental stealth aircraft (White Sands)
runtime_variants.note: Runtime appearance of Aircraft (type 2), not another object type. Used by the parked experimental aircraft at White Sands. Flag 0x2000 replaces near/middle geometry; far detail retains the ordinary aircraft model. Stored colours are still only approximate.

runtime_variants.name: Sun (sky) (earlier geometry)
runtime_variants.note: Renderer-owned sky geometry outside the world-object template table. The stored default uses two concentric discs. Later engines let theatre TWR X directives change angle, size and colour. Shape identity is verified; later-build trigger conditions and pose angles are not assumed.

states.name: Plain sun
states.note: Stored sky appearance.

states.name: Sun with face (stored geometry)
states.note: Original face-and-rays model retained beside the plain sun. No selection trigger has been identified in this build; this control exposes the stored geometry for inspection.

runtime_variants.name: Additional embedded geometry 1cab (earlier geometry)
runtime_variants.note: Complete stored model, recovered by structural scan. Its original use has not been traced; the preview does not claim it is an independently placeable object. Use Neutral geometry if its stored colour is invisible. Shape identity is verified; later-build trigger conditions and pose angles are not assumed.

runtime_variants.name: Farm building (slalom source)
runtime_variants.note: FARM.INC replaces the saucer model when slalom=1. Authored octant lists retain their omitted roof faces. Destruction uses the ordinary fuel-dump wreck, not a tumbling saucer.

states.name: Destroyed
states.note: Slalom bmrtim calls gmdest: the farm becomes the shared fuel-dump wreck and emits twelve fragments. There is no separate collapsed-barn mesh.

runtime_variants.name: Tree (slalom source)
runtime_variants.note: Slalom replaces the shell with a tree. Its far template uses a line trunk. The separate foliage-only helper is also preserved below.

runtime_variants.name: Tree foliage only (unused source helper)
runtime_variants.note: Complete foliage-only tree model stored in the source; the selected slalom object template does not reference it.

runtime_variants.name: Tall Tet marker (slalom source)
runtime_variants.note: normaltet=0 adds a long stem. The course generator places two rows of six markers at different heights.

runtime_variants.name: Pond (slalom source; reused crater geometry)
runtime_variants.note: slalom=1 changes the crater span from 4,000 to 16,000 cm and fixes its colour to blue.

runtime_variants.name: Traffic aircraft (slalom source)
runtime_variants.note: Slalom replaces the saucer-launch site with an aircraft using the ordinary aircraft middle/far models. Three are placed at 1,310.72 m altitude; bmrstim follows their fixed attitude without launching enemies. Type 51 is not boardable.

runtime_colours.note: Random and alternating colours advance once per DOS game frame; the viewer uses 30 preview frames per second. Timer-bit flashing uses the original PIT rate. Random output uses the original multiplicative generator with a fixed preview seed; gameplay consumes random numbers for many other purposes.

runtime_animation.note: Native integer forcefield shapes; captured particle clip loops only for inspection. Frame-driven effects use a 30 fps preview cadence; original cadence depends on gameplay.
